recovered_sequence: Restore the intermediate g_stageLighting[0x5b] difference store before multiplying it in place. Reuse value for scalar differences, interpolation and alpha conversions; convert low RGB after both initial vectors have been interpolated, and ambient RGB before copying the ambient vector. Signed-short weather sentinel matches the original short compare; view pointer is computed before object pointer. Remove obsolete matching comments.
behavior_change: Restored the original intermediate global intensity write; final state, colours and scene calls remain equivalent in all tested cases.
harness_scope: Existing 1620 weather initialisation cases retain complete lighting state/provider parity. 2904 blends additionally execute real fixed-point arithmetic and check an independent signed model, all 94 lighting DWORDs, fog diffuse and distances, every emitted colour/vector/scalar and call order, two intensity stores, complete seeded guarded heap, allowed global writes, poisoned stack and callee ABI. Includes signed product and subtraction wrap, BYTE conversion, negative/oversized factors, INT_MIN/INT_MAX, three view strides/kinds, low/high weather-word guards, view-level threshold, optional fog and prior nonzero reset flag. Mesh/rendering/scene setters remain controlled leaves.
remaining_difference: Colour buffer stack homes, scratch pointer/scalar slot sharing, prologue scheduling, a few scalar interpolation homes and register allocation remain different. Original and rebuilt retain the same 0x90-byte frame.
